states.name: UNKNOWN
requiredInputs: Whatever the candidate state required and did not get
states.referenceLogic: Returned whenever mandatory evidence is missing, unusable, or points at two states at once.
states.expectedBehaviour: No claim is made about the machine.
states.implementationNote: Unknown is safer than falsely applying a steady-production baseline.

states.name: STOPPED
states.physicalMeaning: No intended rotation or production. The barrel may still be hot immediately after shutdown.
states.referenceLogic: Run OFF plus screw RPM near zero plus feed zero, unless a maintenance, purge or manual state overrides.
states.expectedBehaviour: RPM near zero; feed zero; torque and current off or no-load; pressure decays after process stop; temperatures may remain elevated.
states.implementationNote: Do not classify hot barrel temperatures after shutdown as a process fault simply because the machine is stopped.

states.name: WARM_UP
states.physicalMeaning: Barrel zones are heating toward the recipe or setpoint profile before production.
states.referenceLogic: RPM near zero plus no material feed plus one or more heating zones actively approaching setpoint.
states.expectedBehaviour: Temperature rises over time; heater output active; setpoint error reduces; different zones may heat at different normal rates.
states.implementationNote: DOC-03 uses a trajectory or profile baseline here, not a steady-production baseline.

states.name: READY
states.physicalMeaning: Thermal and permissive conditions are satisfied but production has not started.
states.referenceLogic: Required zones inside the configured ready band, no active trip, screw RPM near zero and feed zero.
states.expectedBehaviour: Temperatures near setpoints; low temperature rate of change; no process pressure or throughput.
states.implementationNote: Ready criteria are machine and recipe specific configuration fields, not universal numbers.

states.name: STARTUP
states.physicalMeaning: Rotation and feed are introduced; transients are expected.
states.referenceLogic: Transition from READY or STOPPED into nonzero RPM and/or feed. Remains STARTUP until the defined ramp criteria are met.
states.expectedBehaviour: RPM rises; feed begins; torque and current rise; pressure develops; short transients may be normal.
states.implementationNote: Steady-production fault rules must not be blindly applied here.

states.name: RAMP_UP
states.physicalMeaning: Producing, but feed, RPM, load and process variables are still moving toward target.
states.referenceLogic: Production present plus context still changing, or stability criteria not yet satisfied.
states.expectedBehaviour: Trend toward targets; decreasing variability as stable production is approached.
states.implementationNote: The primary output is "stable enough?" rather than aggressive fault diagnosis.

states.name: STEADY_PRODUCTION
states.physicalMeaning: Stable production under a defined machine, recipe, speed and load context.
states.referenceLogic: Run ON plus feed above minimum plus recipe and configuration unchanged plus RPM, feed and key process variables stable for the validated persistence window.
states.expectedBehaviour: Context stable; full process relationships applicable; eligible for baseline learning only when data quality is GOOD and no anomaly, fault or limit event is active.
states.implementationNote: The primary state for contextual baselines and most Part-1 diagnostics.

states.name: RECIPE_CHANGE
states.physicalMeaning: Recipe, material, product or the commanded thermal/feed profile is intentionally changing.
states.referenceLogic: A change in recipe, material or product, or an explicit transition flag. Freeze old baseline learning until the new context stabilises.
states.expectedBehaviour: Torque, pressure and energy can legitimately change; a new steady context must be selected or learned.
states.implementationNote: A context change is not a fault.

states.name: SHUTDOWN
states.physicalMeaning: Production is intentionally reduced toward zero feed and RPM.
states.referenceLogic: Feed reduction or stop plus RPM reduction, or an explicit shutdown command.
states.expectedBehaviour: Throughput, pressure and torque reduce; temperatures can remain high.
states.implementationNote: Use the shutdown envelope; avoid steady-state false alarms.

states.name: FAULT_TRIP
states.physicalMeaning: A protection or interlock is active.
states.referenceLogic: Explicit high-authority state bit. Overrides any inferred state.
states.implementationNote: Prevents inappropriate baseline learning and false process diagnosis.

states.name: MAINTENANCE
states.referenceLogic: Explicit high-authority state bit. Overrides any inferred state.
states.implementationNote: Prevents inappropriate baseline learning and false process diagnosis.

states.name: PURGE_CLEANING
states.expectedBehaviour: Process variables follow the purge procedure rather than a production envelope.
states.implementationNote: Prevents inappropriate baseline learning and false process diagnosis.

states.name: MANUAL
states.physicalMeaning: Operator or manual control, which may violate automatic relationships.
states.expectedBehaviour: Automatic process relationships may not hold.
states.implementationNote: Usually not eligible for baseline learning.
